title: Days 267–270 final evidence-based closeout
scope: Four-day proposal closeout only: inspect actual earlier gates and outputs, assemble a local reproducible portfolio receipt, review current-version certification evidence, and write honest recovery/carryover. No feature expansion, AWS deployment, credentials, paid calls, exam booking, learner completion or professional-ownership claims.
gate: The current Day 210/238 and Day 252 evidence gate remains dynamic; run it and preserve its actual result. Current absent records are not a permanent failure. Eligibility is only permission to attempt; it is not completion.

days.title: Reconcile actual release gates and local evaluation

project_implementation_tests.task: Run both real prerequisite gate commands and preserve their complete JSON output. Follow only the first reported unmet recovery selector; do not run gated learner selectors while ineligible. Compare the reported evidence paths with actual files.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Both raw gate outputs, exact missing/invalid evidence paths, and the actual next recovery selector; no learner-completion inference.

ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.task: Run the existing three-case deterministic evaluator. Independently compare each case's expected status/citation with the actual result; then change one expected citation in a temporary case and show the exact-match and mismatch counts change.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.evidence: Three case IDs and independent expected/observed rows; exact denominator, counts, and wrong-citation negative-control output.

certification_labs_questions.task: Offline practice: answer one question from the currently linked SAA guide's security domain and check it against that domain's official task statements. If guide/version changed, use the current replacement and record the exact heading.
certification_labs_questions.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-associate-03/solutions-architect-associate-03.html and verify the current guide plus `Content Domain 1: Design Secure Architectures`; write one question, answer and source-backed correction.
certification_labs_questions.evidence: Exact guide title/version/date/heading, question, answer, correction and limitation; no readiness or exam claim.

ai_concept_source_study.task: Read the evaluation workflow stages. Map objective, fixed synthetic dataset, independent labels, metric and comparison to the three existing local cases; identify which claims local data cannot support.
ai_concept_source_study.evidence: Five-stage mapping and one unsupported claim explicitly excluded.

certification_domain_study.task: Recheck SAA version and record the official security-domain task statements used for today's practice.
certification_domain_study.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-associate-03/solutions-architect-associate-03.html and verify `Content Domain 1: Design Secure Architectures`.
certification_domain_study.evidence: Current official guide/version/date and exact heading; no AWS lab or booking.

core_systems_security_cloud_study.task: Compare the local assertion/tenant/scope boundary with the SAA security domain without treating a local test as AWS experience.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-associate-03/solutions-architect-associate-03.html at `Content Domain 1: Design Secure Architectures`.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.evidence: One boundary mapping and explicit no-cloud-use limit.

evidence.task: Record real command output, timestamp, 40-hex source commit SHA, actual paths, separate 64-hex artifact digests, assistance and carryover.
paths: evidence/continuation-267-270/day-267.json (learner-authored only when earned; do not precreate)
evidence.command: git rev-parse HEAD; sha256sum ai/grounded/evaluation.py ai/grounded/evidence.py ai/grounded/tests/test_evaluation.py
evidence.evidence: Actual evidence fields and next action; do not turn an absent gate record into a pass.

shared.task: 45 minutes: closed-book retrieval on SAA-C03 secure architecture constraints. Check the answer against the currently linked official guide and note any gap; no paid practice or exam claim.

days.title: Create a reproducible local portfolio receipt

project_implementation_tests.task: Implement the portfolio receipt starter for the exact selected local files. Require current checked-out 40-hex commit SHA, unique safe existing repository paths, per-file SHA-256 over real bytes and a canonical manifest SHA-256. Never label it a release or completion.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Receipt fields, every artifact path/digest recomputed from bytes, separate source/artifact hashes, and stale/duplicate/missing/traversal negative cases.

ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.task: Inspect the fixed identity contract acceptance matrix and the real TODO state. If the Day 253 gate is eligible, run the selected learner acceptance and report its observed result. If not, use only the instructor witness and fixed fixtures; never count witness output as learner evidence.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.command: python3 -c 'import json,subprocess; g=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["python3","scripts/check_continuation_253_entry_gate.py"],text=True)); print(json.dumps(g,sort_keys=True)); subprocess.run(["python3","-m","unittest","ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_enterprise_contract_253.EnterpriseContractAcceptance.test_day266_reproducible_handoff"],check=True) if g["status"]=="eligible_to_attempt" else print("learner selector skipped; follow gate recovery")'
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.evidence: Current gate JSON, whether selector was allowed/run, exact result and TODO-vs-infrastructure classification; no completion credit.

certification_labs_questions.task: Offline practice: current Developer Associate guide, use its current deployment-related domain if still present. Compare local package/reproducibility concepts only; no AWS deploy or paid lab.
certification_labs_questions.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/developer-associate-02/developer-associate-02.html; recheck exact current guide/version and the matching deployment domain; if changed, record AWS's current heading.
certification_labs_questions.evidence: Current official title/version/heading, one question, checked answer and explicit local/cloud distinction.

ai_concept_source_study.task: Read how to select a bounded evaluation dataset and task-specific metric; assess whether the fixed local identity cases cover ordinary, boundary and adversarial outcomes.
ai_concept_source_study.evidence: Case-to-objective coverage matrix with denominator and one known blind spot.

certification_domain_study.task: Recheck Developer Associate's currently published guide/version and one exact security domain heading.
certification_domain_study.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/developer-associate-02/developer-associate-02.html and verify the current guide plus a security domain heading.
certification_domain_study.evidence: Exact official title/version/date/heading; carry changed domains forward if needed.

core_systems_security_cloud_study.task: Review the security task statements against the local least-privilege assertion check; state why this is not cloud IAM practice.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-associate-03/solutions-architect-associate-03.html at `Content Domain 1: Design Secure Architectures`.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.evidence: One local mapping and a clear AWS deployment limit.

evidence.task: Capture tested source commit SHA and recomputed receipt digest; preserve the learner selector state and any unmet prerequisite.
paths: evidence/continuation-267-270/day-268.json (learner-authored only when earned; do not precreate)
evidence.command: git rev-parse HEAD; python3 ai/grounded/closeout_portfolio_267.py --source-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --path ai/grounded/enterprise_contract_253.py --path ai/grounded/learner_acceptance/test_enterprise_contract_253.py; python3 -m unittest ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_closeout_portfolio_267
evidence.evidence: No placeholder file or self-reported artifact hash without recomputation.

shared.task: 45 minutes: closed-book retrieval on the currently published Developer Associate deployment-related domain. Recheck guide/version first; compare only with local packaging concepts, not AWS deployment.

days.title: Review certification evidence against current guides

project_implementation_tests.task: Implement the offline certification evidence reviewer: exact currently verified guide title/version/domain set, two distinct timed assessments from current official AWS practice materials with source title/URL, >=80% each, full missed-topic review and no unstudied domain. Include a full-length official practice exam only when actually available without purchase; record unavailability otherwise. If official domain diagnostics are supplied, require every domain >=70%. Return only not_ready or a separate booking-review recommendation; never pass/book.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Actual assessment rows, independent ratios, missing/malformed/stale-guide/duplicate/under-threshold controls, no exam_passed/booking_authorized claims.

ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.task: Compare the fixed local evaluator's exact citation/abstention results against independent labels and measure how one deliberately wrong expected label changes exact-match and citation-mismatch counts.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.evidence: Actual result rows, changed denominator if filtered, independent label and incorrect-label mutation result.

certification_labs_questions.task: Use only currently available official free practice material for one SAA domain question. If no official source/result is available, mark readiness evidence unavailable; do not buy practice or substitute guessed quizzes.
certification_labs_questions.command: Recheck https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-associate-03/solutions-architect-associate-03.html and its current exact exam-guide link/version.
certification_labs_questions.evidence: Exact source/version/section, question answer and actual assessment evidence availability; no fabricated score.

ai_concept_source_study.task: Read the eval workflow's metric and run/compare stages. Apply them to actual local output; explain why a fixture-only result cannot establish production quality.
ai_concept_source_study.evidence: Metric definition, observed numerator/denominator and one external-validity limit.

certification_domain_study.task: Recheck the Developer Associate guide version and one troubleshooting domain heading; note any version mismatch before reviewing recorded attempts.
certification_domain_study.command: Open https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/developer-associate-02/developer-associate-02.html and verify the currently published guide plus troubleshooting domain heading.
certification_domain_study.evidence: Exact current version and heading, or explicit unavailable/version-change note.

evidence.task: Record actual review result per credential as not_run, blocked, not_ready or ready_for_separate_booking_review with guide and assessment provenance.
paths: evidence/continuation-267-270/day-269.json (learner-authored only when earned; do not precreate)
evidence.command: git rev-parse HEAD; sha256sum ai/grounded/cert_readiness_267.py ai/grounded/learner_acceptance/test_cert_readiness_267.py; python3 -m unittest ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_cert_readiness_267
evidence.evidence: No exam pass, booking, or readiness inference beyond the explicit internal threshold.

core_systems_security_cloud_study.task: No core systems/security/cloud study is allocated today (0 minutes). Keep certification review inside its assigned category.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.evidence: Record zero allocated minutes; do not claim study coverage.

shared.task: 45 minutes: closed-book retrieval on resilient architecture choices; check one answer against the current official guide and record a knowledge gap.

days.title: Publish the honest closeout and carryover queue

project_implementation_tests.task: Re-run only selectors currently eligible. Reconcile actual 210/238/252 gates, closeout tests and portfolio receipt; write a bounded handoff showing carryovers in priority order. Do not mark a project finished because the calendar ends.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Gate JSON, exact eligible selector outputs, source SHA and actual artifact digests, plus next recovery command.

ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.task: Re-run the three real deterministic policy-explanation cases and all negative controls. Compare exact expected labels, citations and counts. No provider call, model judge or metadata-only claim.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.evidence: All case IDs/results, exact metric counts, negative-control failures and actual code/test digests.

certification_labs_questions.task: For each target, apply the internal readiness rubric only to recorded current official evidence. If evidence is absent, a current free practice resource is unavailable, or thresholds are unmet, record not_ready and carry it forward; never buy material or book an exam.
certification_labs_questions.command: Run `python3 -m unittest ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_cert_readiness_267`; recheck both official guides.
certification_labs_questions.evidence: Separate SAA and Developer status, current guide versions, each source score/review and remaining domains; no pass claim.

ai_concept_source_study.task: Review how task-specific evaluation should evolve; choose one next synthetic case only if actual errors or gaps support it, otherwise record why the current blocker takes priority.
ai_concept_source_study.evidence: A case justified by observed evidence or an explicit no-change decision, with independent expected result.

certification_domain_study.task: Check both official guide landing pages for current titles/versions and list any scope changes to carry beyond Day 270.
certification_domain_study.evidence: Current title/version/date and changed or unchanged domain list; no readiness guarantee.

core_systems_security_cloud_study.task: Review release provenance and rollback/recovery limits for a local-only artifact; no deployment or infrastructure operation.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.command: Review Python's `subprocess` docs at https://docs.python.org/3/library/subprocess.html under `Using the subprocess module`.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.evidence: One local process-failure boundary and explicit no-cloud limit.

evidence.task: Write final factual handoff: gate statuses and recovery selectors; accepted/not_run/blocked learner selectors; portfolio artifact receipt; current guide versions and separate readiness results; assistance/blockers; carryover. Preserve all earlier records.
paths: evidence/continuation-267-270/day-270.json (learner-authored only when earned; do not precreate)

evidence.evidence: No project completion, exam pass, certification readiness beyond threshold, professional ownership or Staff/Principal/FDE claim. Include conditional SDE II and Senior knowledge/application checkpoints only when actual artifacts verify them; Staff/Principal/FDE remain external-evidence carryovers.

shared.task: 45 minutes: retrieve and check one current Developer Associate troubleshooting concept, then carry any gap into the next queue. No paid material, booking or pass claim.
